python.remedy: Install Python 3.12 (minimum 3.10) and put its python3 on the host PATH; restart the host.

git.remedy: Install Git 2.30+ and put git on the host PATH; restart the host.

bash.remedy: Install Bash 3.2+; on Windows use the documented Cygwin runtime.

node.remedy: Install a current Node.js LTS on the host PATH; restart the host. Node is required for PMAI hooks.
